targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(cost_usd), 2) AS cost FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT sum(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT count() AS calls FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT session_id, started, project, host, account,
       left(replaceAll(first_prompt, '\n', ' '), 120) AS first_prompt,
       prompts, round(cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd, tokens, tool_calls, agents_run, skills_run,
       dateDiff('minute', started, last_event) AS minutes
FROM cc.sessions
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
  AND (prompts > 0 OR tokens > 0)
  AND started >= $__fromTime AND started <= $__toTime
ORDER BY started DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Prompts in the selected session
panels.description: Select one session in the variable above (or click a session_id).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(ts) AS time,
       left(replaceAll(anyIf(prompt, event = 'user_prompt'), '\n', ' '), 160) AS prompt,
       round(sumIf(cost_usd, event = 'api_request'), 3) AS cost_usd,
       sumIf(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens, event = 'api_request') AS tokens,
       countIf(event = 'tool_result') AS tool_calls,
       countIf(event = 'subagent_completed') AS agents,
       arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(skill_name, event = 'skill_activated'), ', ') AS skills
FROM cc.events
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND '${session}' != '__all' AND prompt_id != ''
GROUP BY prompt_id
ORDER BY time

SELECT actor, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY actor ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, actor, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time, actor ORDER BY time

SELECT t.actor AS agent, t.runs, t.tokens, t.cost_usd, ifNull(c.tool_calls, 0) AS tool_calls
FROM
(
    SELECT actor, uniqExact(agent_id) AS runs, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, round(sum(cost_usd), 3) AS cost_usd
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id != ''
    GROUP BY actor
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT actor, count() AS tool_calls FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id != '' GROUP BY actor
) AS c USING (actor)
ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT s.skill AS skill, s.launches, ifNull(t.tokens, 0) AS tokens, ifNull(t.cost_usd, 0) AS cost_usd,
       ifNull(c.tool_calls, 0) AS tool_calls, s.triggers
FROM
(
    SELECT skill_name AS skill, count() AS launches,
           arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(skill_trigger), ', ') AS triggers
    FROM cc.events WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'skill_activated'
    GROUP BY skill
) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT skill, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, round(sum(cost_usd), 3) AS cost_usd
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND skill != '' GROUP BY skill
) AS t ON s.skill = t.skill
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT skill, count() AS tool_calls
    FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND skill != '' GROUP BY skill
) AS c ON s.skill = c.skill
ORDER BY launches DESC

SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT actor, if(skill = '', '-', skill) AS skill, tool_name,
       count() AS calls, countIf(NOT success) AS errors, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY actor, skill, tool_name
ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT bash_cmd AS command, actor, count() AS calls, countIf(NOT success) AS errors
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND tool_name = 'Bash'
GROUP BY command, actor ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT tool_name, decision_source AS source, count() AS rejected
FROM cc.events
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'tool_decision' AND decision = 'reject'
GROUP BY tool_name, source ORDER BY rejected DESC

panels.title: Files (paths relative to project; worktrees folded in)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT path, area,
       countIf(op = 'read') AS reads, countIf(op = 'write') AS writes, countIf(op = 'search') AS searches,
       count() AS total, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions,
       arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(actor), ', ') AS actors,
       arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(skill, skill != ''), ', ') AS skills
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND path != ''
GROUP BY path, area ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Accesses by area
panels.description: claude-context = claude-context/ and .claude/; external = outside the project folder

targets.rawSql:
SELECT area, count() AS accesses
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND area != ''
GROUP BY area ORDER BY accesses DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT dir, countIf(op = 'read') AS reads, countIf(op = 'write') AS writes,
       countIf(op = 'search') AS searches, count() AS total
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND dir != ''
GROUP BY dir ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Files re-read within one session (context churn)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT session_id, path, count() AS reads
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND op = 'read' AND path != ''
GROUP BY session_id, path HAVING reads > 2
ORDER BY reads DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT hook_name, count() AS runs, round(sum(hook_duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS total_s,
       round(avg(hook_duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM cc.events WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'hook_execution_complete'
GROUP BY hook_name ORDER BY total_s DESC
